entryOpportunity.companyName: Union Square Ventures-backed Sports Collectibles Startup
entryOpportunity.postingDetails:
Be the first dedicated strategy hire at a fast-growing sports and trading-card collectibles app, working directly with the CEO on cash flow, inventory, financing and the next big bets.

## The opportunity The hiring client is a Toronto-based consumer startup that turns collecting into play: users rip packs of real trading cards (TCG and sports) from anywhere and collect rewards along the way. It is built by the team behind a sports prediction app with millions of users, is backed by Union Square Ventures, KB Partners and Kevin Durant's 35 Ventures, and has crossed eight figures in GMV. This is the company's first dedicated strategy hire. You will report to the CEO and work with the VP Product, VP Growth and the leadership team to find blind spots and fix them before they get expensive. Because the business sells physical goods, the work comes with real inventory, cash-flow, regulatory and operational complexity. This is a high-intensity, hands-on role, not a slide-deck role. ## What you will do - Own forecasting, cash flow and financing options, and help tell a sharp story when the company raises. - Make the inventory bets, model unit economics and make sure operations scale ahead of demand. - Spot tax, legal and regulatory risks early, including the ones nobody has thought of yet. - Build the case for new markets, categories and partnerships, then negotiate the terms and chase the timeline until it lands. - Help leadership work out who the team is missing, how to find them and how to keep everyone shipping. ## What you will bring - 4-8 years in strategy, BizOps or finance, ideally consulting, banking or PE followed by a high-growth consumer, e-commerce or marketplace company. - Exceptional drive and agency: you see what needs doing and do it without waiting for a brief or a perfect dataset. - AI-native working habits: you use AI tools daily to research, model, analyze and automate. - Fluency in the numbers: forecasts, unit economics and cash-flow models built without a template. - Experience with physical goods, inventory or logistics, or the appetite to get your hands dirty in them. - Real deal-negotiation experience and the willingness to bring the counter-argument to leadership. - Excellent written communication, and some interest in TCGs, sports cards or collectibles. ## Why consider it A seat at the leadership table of a high-velocity startup with real revenue and real users, unusually broad scope, and a shot at defining gamified collectibles commerce. Compensation is CAD 120K-160K plus equity. The role is on-site in Toronto.

🇨🇦 Toronto, Ontario, Canada

CAD 120,000–160,000 per year + equity

한국 영업팀이 일하는 방식을 다른 나라에도 만들어보는 게 끌려요. 지금도 세일즈포스에서 계약 진행 단계를 제가 다시 설계했고 매주 매출 예측도 해요. 영어 회의나 보고서는 괜찮아요. 직함만 글로벌이고 계속 보고서 취합하는 건 싫어요.
한국에서 APAC 쪽 영업 운영을 직접 맡는 자리가 좋아요. 근데 그런 회사들 한국에서 뽑아놓고 미국팀 숫자만 정리하는 경우도 있잖아요. 지금 6,500인데 7,500 정도 받고 진짜 그 일을 하면 옮기고 싶어요.
첫 분기부터 맡을 시장이 있는지 먼저 알아봐 주세요. 그런 곳이라면 만나보고 싶어요.

followups.message: 지금 1억 5천이라 돈은 올라요. 근데 또 고객사마다 다른 시스템을 만드는 일이에요. 작년에 출장 정말 많이 다녔거든요.
한 제품에서 검색이 나중에 어떻게 되는지 계속 보고 싶어요. 제가 만든 검색이 나중에 왜 틀리는지까지 보고 싶은데, 납품하면 다른 데로 배정되거든요. 서울에서 한 제품을 오래 맡을 수 있고 기본급이 1억 7천 정도면 좋아요. 영어는 괜찮아요.
하나의 제품이라고 해도 고객사별로 문서 검색만 붙여주는 거면 비슷하지 않아요? 실제로 다르게 일하는 팀이 궁금해요.
그런 팀은 정말 만나보고 싶은데, 금요일까지 다른 전형을 끝낼 수는 없잖아요.
지금 오퍼를 준 회사에는 기한 연장부터 부탁하고, 저한테 맞는 다른 팀이 있으면 그쪽에도 연락해 주세요.
